title_sq: Dupleks per shitje 3+1+2 te Kopshti Zoologjik
description_sq:
Dupleks per shitje 3+1+2 te Kopshti Zoologjik
Dupleks 3+1+2 për shitje te Liqeni i Tiranës te rruga Eduart Mano! Dupleksi ndodhet në katin e 4-t edhe të fundit ,i ka një sipërfaqe totale prej 171 m².
Dupleksi ka një planimetri të rregullt me hapësira spacioze, organizohet në hyrjen kryesore ne sallonin e ndenjies i cili eshte teje spacioz. kendi i gatimit i cili eshte i vecuar nga pjesa e ndenjies, 1 dhome gjumi edhe tualeti i dites.
Eshte lene projekti gati per vendosjen e shkalleve te cilat na ngjisin ne katin e dyte ku nodhen 2 dhoma gjumi edhe nje tualet. Dupleksi ka nje orientim jug lindje perendime, me nje ndricim edhe ngrohje natyrale gjate gjithe dites.
Ambienti eshte lene ne rifiniturat perfundimtare per ta personalizuar sipas kerkeses se bleresit per te cilat mund te arrihen nje marreveshje. Fotot e bashkangjitura jane rendera opsional. Ka nje vendodhje shume te mire, ne fillim te rruges Eduart Mano, pak m nga rruga kryesore me akses te shpejt prane unazes se madhe edhe liqenit te Tiranes.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor!
title_en: Duplex for sale 3+1+2 in the Zoo
description_en: Duplex for sale 3+1+2 in the Zoo Duplex 3+1+2 for sale in Lake Tirana on Eduart Mano Street! The duplex is located on the 4th and last floor, it has a total area of ​​171 m². The duplex has a regular layout with spacious spaces, it is organized at the main entrance in the living room, which is very spacious. the kitchen, which is separate from the living room, 1 bedroom and the toilet of the day. The project is ready for the placement of the stairs that lead us to the second floor where there are 2 bedrooms and a bathroom. The duplex has a south-east-west orientation, with natural lighting and heating throughout the day. The environment is left in the final refinishing to personalize it according to the buyer's request for which an agreement can be reached. The attached photos are optional renders. It has a very good location, at the beginning of Eduart Mano street, a few meters from the main road with quick access, near the big ring and the lake of Tirana. Has regular mortgage documentation!
